parameters.help_en: The URL of the target image for sky segmentation. We recommend that you use an Object Storage Service (OSS) URL in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the Shanghai region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
